# Torvane TX-40 Sensor Specification, Revision 1 (SUPERSEDED)

**Issuer:** Calderwick Analytics, Instrument Engineering
**Effective:** 2029-06-10
**Status:** superseded on 2031-02-01 by Revision 2. Retained for audit only.

> This document is retained solely so that historical compliance filings can be
> interpreted. Do not quote its parameters as current.

## 1. Normative parameters (historical)

| Parameter | Revision 1 value |
| --- | --- |
| Calibration interval | 180 days |
| Accuracy | ±2.5% volumetric water content |
| Operating temperature range | -5 °C to 50 °C |
| Reference firmware | 3.0.7 |
| Cell life at 15-minute sampling | 6.0 years |

## 2. Calibration obligations (historical)

- A single-point calibration was required every 180 days.
- Calibration events were to be logged within 7 days.

## 3. Note on the frit

Revision 1 did not describe sulfate crust formation. The failure mode was first
characterised in 2030 and appears only in Revision 2.
